summary: Citizens Northern Corporation filed an 8-K under Item 8.01 solely to announce that its Board of Directors declared a regular quarterly cash dividend of $0.28 per share, payable May 15, 2026 to holders of record as of May 4, 2026. No other events, transactions, or structural changes are disclosed. The filing includes a press release as Exhibit 99. This is a routine dividend declaration with no special-situation characteristics such as an acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, or restructuring. No deal terms, advisors, or strategic actions are mentioned.
